description: TapStream - On-Device Music Streaming & Audio Telegram Bot for Android with yt-dlp/stream resolver integration and native phone speaker playback

userStories.title: TelegramApiClient Audio Delivery Extensions (sendAudio)
userStories.description: As a user, I want the bot to send playable audio tracks directly to Telegram chat via sendAudio using direct stream URLs or audio files.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement sendAudio with audio stream URL, title, performer, duration, caption, and parseMode in TelegramApiClient
Implement sendAudio with multipart File upload for cached/downloaded audio files
Unit test sendAudio request building and parameter serialization in core:network
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: sendAudio implemented in TelegramApiClient with URL streaming and multipart file upload, SendAudioPayload added to model, and all core:network unit tests pass.

userStories.title: Audio Stream Resolver Service (AudioStreamResolver)
userStories.description: As a user, I want the bot to search and resolve audio streams from YouTube/yt-dlp APIs, audio URLs, and curated 24/7 radio stations.
acceptanceCriteria: Create AudioStreamResolver supporting search queries, direct audio links, and custom yt-dlp API endpoints
Include curated 24/7 internet radio stations (Lofi Girl, Synthwave, Chillhop, Classic Rock, Jazz FM) with zero-buffering stream URLs
Parse track metadata (title, artist, durationSeconds, streamUrl, thumbnailUrl)
Unit test stream resolution, search fallbacks, and radio station indexing in core:runner
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: AudioStreamResolver implemented with direct audio links, custom yt-dlp API integration, 6 curated zero-buffer 24/7 radio stations, and comprehensive unit tests passing.

userStories.title: On-Device Android Audio Player Engine (DeviceAudioPlayer)
userStories.description: As a user, I want the bot to physically stream and play music out loud on the Android phone speakers or connected Bluetooth sound system.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement DeviceAudioPlayer wrapping Android MediaPlayer with async stream preparation and error recovery
Implement playback control: play, pause, resume, stop, seekTo, and AudioManager volume scaling (0-100)
Expose real-time PlaybackState flow (status, currentTrack, elapsedMs, durationMs, volumePct)
Include JVM test fallback so unit tests run cleanly without native Android audio hardware
Unit test playback states, queue progression, and volume control in core:runner
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: TapStream Music Bot Runtime & Interactive Command Router
userStories.description: As a user, I want Telegram playback commands (/play, /pause, /resume, /stop, /skip, /queue, /nowplaying, /volume, /send, /radio, /mode).
acceptanceCriteria: Upgrade MusicBotRuntime to integrate AudioStreamResolver, DeviceAudioPlayer, and TelegramApiClient sendAudio
Support dual playback modes: SPEAKER (phone hardware audio) and CHAT (sendAudio in Telegram)
Implement /nowplaying with visual ASCII time progress bar (▶ 01:23 ━━━━●──────── 03:45)
Implement /radio command for instant 24/7 streaming station selection
Unit test all music commands, queue transitions, and mode switching in core:runner
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
